Bucket Policy (JSON)

ℹ️ Versioning allows you to keep multiple variants of an object in the same bucket to protect against accidental deletions or overwrites.
Disabled

Once versioning is enabled, it can only be Suspended, not completely removed. Disabling the toggle above will suspend versioning, which stops creating new versions but retains existing ones.

ℹ️ CORS allows web applications from other domains to interact with your bucket directly.
